newsitem.title: JAPAN: Belgium launches $500 mln Euro-Asian bond - UBS.
newsitem.headline: Belgium launches $500 mln Euro-Asian bond - UBS.

text.p: Belgium has launched a $500 million five-year Euro-Asian bond due on March 25, 2002, the Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS), one of the joint lead managers, said on Tuesday.
The bonds will be priced nine basis points over a five-year U.S. Treasury note and the pricing time will be at or before 3.30 p.m. (1530 GMT) in London, UBS said.
The other lead manager is Morgan Stanley.
The payment date will be March 25 and the bond will be listed in Luxembourg and Singapore.
The bond is rated Aa1 by Moody's Investors Service and AA+ by Standard & Poor's.
